description: Finder / Explorer-class file, document and records manager on a pluggable storage adapter: icons / list / columns / gallery views, real content thumbnails (images, video frames, text/CSV/Markdown pages, audio waveforms, server renditions; pdf.js optional plugin), preview pane, Quick Look, Get Info inspector with document records (type, number, parties, expiry reminders, approval, OCR), versions, sharing, tags, drag & drop, marquee, clipboard, uploads with pause/resume and conflict resolution, trash; phones: Files-app layout.
